source: user-provided, 2026-07-23; exact quantities + character-level costs confirmed 2026-07-24 from in-game calculator screenshots
notes: Corrects a scraping-pipeline misconception. skillParams.json's `unlockLevel` field (parsed from ability-text meta like "(Level 1)" or "(unlock level N)") does NOT reliably represent a fixed game-design threshold — do not use it for cost/benefit modeling. 195/236 captured skills show unlockLevel=1 simply because Level 1 is the skill-level the screenshot happened to be taken at (the baseline capture used to seed characters.json), not a true unlock gate.

The true mechanic: a hero's skill slots are gated by character-level thresholds (skillSlotUnlockCharacterLevel), and each skill's own Level 1-15 progression costs Gold + Molecular Enhancements (+ Special Molecular Enhancements at checkpoints). Skill 1 is unlocked free on recruit; levels 2-15 cost per skillLevelCosts below.

2026-07-24: exact per-level costs confirmed (skillLevelCosts). The earlier assumption that Special Molecular Enhancements are needed 'every 3 tiers (3/6/9/12/15)' was WRONG — they are actually required at levels 4, 7, 10, and then EVERY level 11-15 (see specialMolecularEnhancement.checkpointLevels, now confirmed).

2026-07-24: character-level (account XP) cost to raise one hero confirmed (characterLevelCost). 'Blue' = Hero XP, 'Pink' = Hero Special XP. These are per-hero and independent of rarity; rarity only changes how many skills exist to level (Common 1 / Rare 3 / Elite 4).

maxedHeroCostByRarity is the derived bottom line — what one fully maxed hero (character Level 1000 + all its skills at Level 15) actually costs. This is the number the roster optimizer prices against so it doesn't casually recommend maxing five expensive heroes. Common heroes cannot rank/level up meaningfully (1 skill, Level 1) and are effectively free — which is exactly why the documented metas use them as disposable Level-1 sacrifice bodies.

Currency acquisition: Molecular / Special Molecular Enhancements are farmed via the GDA Op 'Well Done', Cecil's Nightmares, or the in-game equipment shop. Gold and Hero/Hero-Special XP come from most ops.

skillSlotUnlockCharacterLevel.note: Character (account) level required before a given skill slot can be used/upgraded at all. Independent of the skill's own Level 1-15 track. A Rare hero (3 skills) needs level 950 for its last slot; an Elite (4 skills) needs 1000.

skillLevelCosts.note: Cost to raise ONE skill from the previous level to `level`. Skill 1 unlocks free on recruit; there is no Level-1 cost. Identical for every skill that can reach Level 15. Gold + molecularEnhancement always; specialMolecularEnhancement only at checkpoint levels.

characterLevelCost.note: Account-XP + gold cost to raise one hero's character level. blueXp = Hero XP, pinkXp = Hero Special XP. Per-hero, independent of rarity.

maxedHeroCostByRarity.note: Character Level 1000 + every skill at Level 15. Common excluded — Common heroes have 1 skill, cannot rank/level up, and cost ~nothing (used as disposable Level-1 bodies).

molecularEnhancement.role: Standard per-level skill upgrade cost, applies to all skills.

specialMolecularEnhancement.role: Additional cost required at skill-level checkpoints (4, 7, 10, then every level 11-15), on top of the standard Molecular Enhancement cost. The scarcest skill currency.
